sources.title: Sweden Abroad: Embassy travel information for Nicaragua

sources.title: Sweden Abroad: Embassy travel information for Ukraine

sources.title: Sweden Abroad: Embassy travel information for Jordan

sources.supportingExcerpt: Svenska medborgare kan ansöka om visum på samtliga flygplatser samt vid följande gränsövergångar.

sources.title: Bangladesh Special Branch: visa on arrival instructions
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Bangladesh Police Special Branch visa-on-arrival service defines the ordinary visitor facility and expressly includes European-country citizens among eligible tourism travellers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: European countries to Bangladesh for tourism, trade, investment, or a government job may get a visa on arrival.

policies.title: Swedish ordinary passports: named visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Current Sweden Abroad guidance establishes visa-free short visitor stays for Swedish citizens in Kazakhstan, Nicaragua and Ukraine.
conditions: KZ: up to 30 days. NI: shorter than 90 days. UA: up to 90 days in a 180-day period.

NI's electronic entry form is an entry form, not an ETA or visa. KZ border-zone permits, Ukraine's security situation, and all work, residence, special-passport, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Swedish ordinary passports: named arrival visitor visas
policies.summary: Current official Swedish and Bangladesh guidance establishes arrival-issued visitor visa routes for Jordan and Bangladesh.
conditions: JO: apply at airports or the specified Jordan-Israel land crossings. BD: European-country citizens may receive a maximum 30-day tourism visa at the port of entry, subject to the immigration officer's discretion.

The Bangladesh route follows the explicitly named European-country eligibility class that includes Sweden, not a conclusion from an online form. Entry point, passport validity, fees, supporting documents, work, residence, special passports and final admission remain separate.
